program: APPUI-01 - Phase 1 Application UI Architecture and Layout
approved_structural_rules: One coherent application architecture may reorganize by task.
The Stage remains a distinct dark dominant performance field and its visual successor is deferred to Phase 2.
Durable navigation may recede by task and must sacrifice space before the primary task does.
Inspectors are contextual capacity relationships, not permanently visible right-edge requirements.
Supporting performance information is available on demand rather than permanently consuming Stage area.
Causal inspection supports both quick adjacent depth and expanded deep investigation without becoming a permanent global History mode.
Character-bounded perspective is the same Production under changed disclosure, not a separate application mode.
Wide, medium and narrow layouts preserve semantic relationships while collapsing secondary UI before the primary task.
The current frozen five-presence Stage placeholder is a baseline witness, not a product cast-cardinality law.
Functional state language such as provisional/effective remains placeholder terminology until product authority freezes final UX vocabulary.
explicit_non_authority: The left icon rail is schematic and does not freeze final navigation placement, labels or iconography.
The right-side inspector examples show adjacency capacity only; they do not freeze right-edge placement.
The internal Production-shaping panel arrangement is not approved and remains the next focused design problem.
No final typography, palette, material, icon, motion, Stage lighting, Character art, transcript placement, timer/Pause, provider/cost, Take, branching or rehearsal UX is selected.
No WinUI/XAML/runtime/package/Store implementation authority is created.
director_reaction: Approved the revised structural direction and agreed to freeze the global grammar subject to the explicit non-authority caveats.
next: Stop reopening the global shell. Produce focused detailed Phase-1 studies for Production Home / Resume and Production Shaping / Current Possibility, using recovered UI-layout lineage without allowing the shaping workspace to become a generic dashboard or ontology-shaped grid.
